summary: There's a part of you that knows deep feelings and a strong need to feel safe and a fast, restless mind are fused in you — you can't run one without the other. At your best, you read people and care on instinct and you think and talk your way through anything. At the edge, your moods run you, or you bury what you actually need.
body: There's a part of you that knows deep feelings and a strong need to feel safe and a fast, restless mind are fused in you — you can't run one without the other. At your best, you read people and care on instinct and you think and talk your way through anything. At the edge, your moods run you, or you bury what you actually need. Communication colored by mood; powerful when feeling and reasoning are integrated. Feelings may need language here. Care can become easier to understand when emotion has a way to be named, shared, or talked through.
gift: At your best: you read people and care on instinct, and you think and talk your way through anything.
shadow: The trap: your moods run you, or you bury what you actually need — or you overthink it, or talk when you should feel.
integration: Let emotional needs and thinking and speech cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Communication colored by mood; powerful when feeling and reasoning are integrated.
do: Use it on purpose, not on reflex
Let you read people and you think work together
When it spikes, name it before you act
dont: Let the reflex make the decision
